item.title: na.rn type strange behavour
item.description:
Is this some sort of bug in dplyr?
Notice the type, instead of na.rm it is na.rn and it gives the sum of the row plus one when set to true.
library(tidyverse)
data = tibble(col1 = c(1, 1, 2, 2), col2 = c(1, 2, 3, 4))
data %>% group_by(col1) %>% summarise(col2 = sum(col2, na.rn = T))
data %>% group_by(col1) %>% summarise(col2 = sum(col2, na.rn = F))
